# Ayodhya Dharshan - Teerth Yatra Seva

Authorized, local tour operator providing fully-managed family pilgrimages and tour packages across Ayodhya, Varanasi (Kashi), Prayagraj, Chitrakoot, Mathura, Vrindavan, and the complete Ramayana Circuit. Highly specialized in senior citizen-friendly arrangements, premium AC transport, and fast-track VIP temple entry.

## Core Pilgrimage Packages

- [Ayodhya Same Day Tour](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-same-day-tour.html): Day-long pilgrimage covering Ram Janmabhoomi, Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhawan, and Saryu Aarti with local AC cabs.
- [Varanasi Same Day Tour](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/varanasi-same-day-tour-package.html): Local darshan of Kashi Vishwanath, Annapurna Temple, Sarnath, and evening Ganga Aarti.
- [Ayodhya Dharshan Package (3 Days)](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-dharshan-tour-package.html): Deep family yatra in Ayodhya covering all major ghats and historic temples.
- [Ayodhya Prayagraj Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-prayagraj-tour-package.html): Holy journey connecting Ram Janmabhoomi and Triveni Sangam.
- [Ayodhya Varanasi Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-varanasi-tour-package.html): Spiritual circuit connecting Kashi Vishwanath and Ayodhya Ram Mandir.
- [Ayodhya Prayagraj Varanasi Package](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-prayagraj-varanasi-tour-package.html): The complete holy trinity of Uttar Pradesh yatra (Kashi, Prayag, Ayodhya).
- [5-City Holy Tour (Varanasi-Prayagraj-Chitrakoot-Ayodhya)](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/ayodhya-prayagraj-chitrakoot-varanasi-tour-package.html): Extensive 6-Day pilgrimage including Kashi, Triveni Sangam, Vindhyachal, Chitrakoot, and Ayodhya.
- [Full Ramayana Circuit](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/full-ramayana-circuit-tour-package.html): All major sites of Lord Ram's journey in Uttar Pradesh.
- [Mathura Vrindavan Tour](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/mathura-vrindavan-tour-package.html): Braj Bhumi pilgrimage covering Krishna Janmabhoomi, Banke Bihari, and Prem Mandir.

## Logistical Travel Guides & Blogs

- [VIP Darshan Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-vip-darshan-ayodhya-ram-mandir.html): Detailed walkthrough on booking VIP entry, Sugam passes, and Aarti tickets at Ram Janmabhoomi.
- [Ayodhya to Varanasi Distance & Travel Guide](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-to-varanasi-distance-travel-guide.html): Road, train, highway routes, and duration details between the two holy cities.
- [Ayodhya Tour Cost from Delhi](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-ayodhya-tour-package-from-delhi-cost.html): Comprehensive price breakdown including trains, flights, hotels, and transport options.
- [Best Time to Visit Ayodhya](https://www.ayodhyadharshan.com/blog-best-time-to-visit-ayodhya.html): Weather, festivals (Diwali, Ram Navami), and ideal months for comfortable family yatras.
